name: society-mgmt-300k
description: Society management test project (backprop integration). Synthetic JavaScript codebase of standalone functions organized across src/ and tests/.

scripts.compile: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),vm=require('vm');const roots=['src','tests'].filter(d=>fs.existsSync(d));function walk(d){let o=[];for(const e of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const p=path.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory())o=o.concat(walk(p));else if(e.name.endsWith('.js'))o.push(p);}return o;}let files=[];for(const r of roots)files=files.concat(walk(r));let errors=0;for(const f of files){try{new vm.Script(fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'),{filename:f});}catch(e){errors++;console.error('SYNTAX ERROR: '+f+' -> '+e.message);}}console.log('Syntax-checked '+files.length+' file(s); errors: '+errors);process.exit(errors?1:0);"
